verdict.rationale: The only startup-oriented offering with stated terms is Founders Workbench, a free resource whose Document Driver® tool generates Delaware C-Corp or LLC formation documents at no cost. That is a named free self-serve program, not a published fee arrangement for legal representation. Goodwin's own practice pages describe serving over 1,200 emerging companies but disclose no fee terms. Missing for 10: published deferred-fee terms, a fixed-fee formation package for attorney services, a named startup legal program with stated pricing or eligibility on goodwinlaw.com, and explicit evidence on the pages linking Founders Workbench to Goodwin.
